Claim 11 (currently amended): A method for training a molecular properties model, comprising: obtaining a pseudo-partial ordering of molecules, wherein the pseudo partial ordering includes at least a representation of a first and second molecule, ordered relative to one another and a property of interest; executing a computational machine to generate a representation of the molecules included in the pseudo partial ordering of molecules that is appropriate for a selected machine learning algorithm, wherein the pseudo partial ordering of molecules is provided to the selected machine learning algorithm conducted on a physical machine, and wherein executing the selected machine learning algorithm, using the pseudo partial ordering, trains a molecular properties model configured to generate a prediction regarding additional molecules supplied to the model.

Claim 12 (currently amended): The method of claim 11, wherein the molecular properties model generates predictions related to a property of interest selected from at least one of a pharmacokinetic property, pharmacodynamic property, physiological or pharmacological activity, toxicity or selectivity; a chemical property including reactivity, binding affinity, pKa, or a property of a specific atom or bond in a molecule; or a physical property including melting point, solubility, a membrane permeability, and a force-field parameter, executed on a machine.

Claim 13 (currently amended): The method of claim 11, wherein the selected machine learning algorithm comprises a classification learning algorithm executed on a machine.

Claim 15 (currently amended): The method of claim 11, wherein the selected machine learning algorithm comprises a variant of a Boosting algorithm, RankBoost algorithm, Alternating Decision Trees algorithm, Support Vector Machines algorithm, a Perceptron algorithm, Winnow, a Hedge Algorithm, decision trees, neural networks, genetic algorithms, genetic programming or any modifications thereof specifically configured to execute on a machine, modified to process the pseudo partial ordering of ranked pairs.

Claim 16 (currently amended): The method of claim 11, wherein the selected machine learning algorithm is configured to minimize, either directly or indirectly, an area above, or below, a receiver operator characteristic curve, executed on a machine.

Claim 17 (currently amended): The method of claim 11, wherein the selected machine learning algorithm is configured to minimize, either directly or indirectly, a function of the rank ordering of molecules in the pseudo partial ordering, executed on a machine.

Claim 19 (currently amended): The method of claim 11, wherein generating the representation of the molecules included in the pseudo partial ordering of molecules comprises: generating a vector representation of the molecules, wherein the vector representation is configured to encode the structure of the molecules included the pseudo-partial ordering; or comprises generating an n-point pharmacophore representation of the molecules included in the pseudo-partial ordering, executed on a machine.

Claim 35 (currently amended): A computer-storage medium containing a program which, when executed by a processor, performs a method for training a molecular properties model, comprising: receiving a pseudo-partial ordering of molecules on a physical computer, wherein the pseudo partial ordering includes at least a representation of a first and second molecule, ordered relative to one another and a property of interest; and executing a computational machine to generate a representation of the molecules included in the pseudo partial ordering of molecules that is appropriate for a selected machine learning algorithm, wherein the pseudo partial ordering of molecules is provided to the selected machine learning algorithm conducted on a physical machine, and wherein executing the selected machine learning algorithm, using the pseudo partial ordering, trains a molecular properties model configured to generate a prediction regarding additional molecules supplied to the model.
